# 2 Dotplot for Jacob's basal gene markers

```{r}
genes_to_check <- c(
  # Jacob et al. BasalTagln-associated genes
  "C1qtnf3", "Hapln1", "Tagln", "Cldn11",
  "Amtn", "Myl9", "Bambi", "Wnt2", "Wnt3a", "Wnt4", "Wnt6"
)

genes_to_check <- unique(genes_to_check)
```

```{r}
display_order <- c(
  "stem cells",
  "Transit",
  "K14(-)",
  "K5(-)",
  "Mature K5(-)",
  "Shh(+)",
  "K6+ cells"
)

## ggplot 的 y 轴第一个 level 会显示在最下方，
## 因此这里反转 levels，使图中从上到下符合 display_order
desired_order <- rev(display_order)

Palate_epi_this_study$level1_anno <- factor(
  Palate_epi_this_study$level1_anno,
  levels = desired_order
)

Idents(Palate_epi_this_study) <- "level1_anno"

table(Idents(Palate_epi_this_study))
```
Extract RNA data
```{r}
## =========================================================
## Extract RNA expression matrix
## =========================================================

exp_mat <- GetAssayData(
  object = Palate_epi_this_study,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

## 必须根据当前实际提取的 RNA data matrix 重新检查
genes_present <- intersect(
  genes_to_check,
  rownames(exp_mat)
)

genes_missing <- setdiff(
  genes_to_check,
  rownames(exp_mat)
)

cat("Genes present in RNA data layer:\n")
print(genes_present)

cat("\nGenes missing from RNA data layer:\n")
print(genes_missing)

## 确认至少有一个基因存在
if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
  stop("None of the requested genes were found in the RNA data layer.")
}

## 按 genes_to_check 中的原始顺序排列
genes_present <- genes_to_check[
  genes_to_check %in% rownames(exp_mat)
]

## 再进行提取
exp_mat <- exp_mat[
  genes_present,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
```
```{r}
meta_use <- Palate_epi_this_study@meta.data

common_cells <- intersect(
  colnames(exp_mat),
  rownames(meta_use)
)

exp_mat <- exp_mat[, common_cells, drop = FALSE]
meta_use <- meta_use[common_cells, , drop = FALSE]

meta_use$level1_anno <- factor(
  meta_use$level1_anno,
  levels = desired_order
)

table(meta_use$level1_anno, useNA = "ifany")
```


```{r}
## =========================================================
## Calculate average expression and percent expressed
## =========================================================

dot_df <- lapply(genes_present, function(gene_i) {
  
  exp_i <- as.numeric(exp_mat[gene_i, ])
  
  data.frame(
    cell = common_cells,
    gene = gene_i,
    expression = exp_i,
    level1_anno = meta_use$level1_anno
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  filter(!is.na(level1_anno)) %>%
  group_by(level1_anno, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_exp = mean(expression),
    pct_exp = mean(expression > 0) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## 对每个 gene 的平均表达进行 scaling，
## 模拟 Seurat DotPlot 的颜色逻辑
dot_df <- dot_df %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_exp_scaled = as.numeric(scale(avg_exp))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

## 若某个基因在所有 cell type 中平均值完全相同，
## scale() 会产生 NA，将其设为 0
dot_df$avg_exp_scaled[
  is.na(dot_df$avg_exp_scaled)
] <- 0

## 限制极端值
dot_df$avg_exp_scaled <- pmax(
  pmin(dot_df$avg_exp_scaled, 2.5),
  -2.5
)

## 设置 gene 顺序
dot_df$gene <- factor(
  dot_df$gene,
  levels = genes_present
)

## 设置细胞类型顺序
dot_df$level1_anno <- factor(
  dot_df$level1_anno,
  levels = desired_order
)
```


```{r}
## =========================================================
## DotPlot
## =========================================================

p_dot_Palate_epi_this_study_marker_custom <- ggplot(
  dot_df,
  aes(
    x = gene,
    y = level1_anno
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = pct_exp,
      color = avg_exp_scaled
    )
  ) +
  scale_size(
    range = c(0, 6),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    name = "Percent\nExpressed"
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("#295B9F", "#FFFFFF", "#D23B3E"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5)),
    limits = c(-2.5, 2.5),
    name = "Average\nExpression"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 10
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(order = 1),
    size = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

p_dot_Palate_epi_this_study_marker_custom
```
```{r}
ggsave(
  "./OutputFigure/Palate_zhao_thi_study_embryonic_skin_progenitor_markers_dotplot.pdf",
  plot = p_dot_Palate_epi_this_study_marker_custom,
  width = 5,
  height = 10
)

```

# 3 Module score
```{r}
DefaultAssay(Palate_epi_this_study) <- "RNA"

## 完整的 Jacob et al. BasalTagln-associated gene set
jacob_basalTagln_full <- c(
  "C1qtnf3", "Hapln1", "Tagln", "Cldn11",
  "Amtn", "Myl9", "Bambi",
  "Wnt2", "Wnt3a", "Wnt4", "Wnt6"
)

## 更保守的核心 gene set：
## 去掉可能在多个 epithelial state 中广泛表达的 Wnt genes
jacob_basalTagln_core <- c(
  "C1qtnf3", "Hapln1", "Tagln", "Cldn11",
  "Amtn", "Myl9", "Bambi"
)
```

```{r}
jacob_full_present <- intersect(
  jacob_basalTagln_full,
  rownames(Palate_epi_this_study[["RNA"]])
)

jacob_core_present <- intersect(
  jacob_basalTagln_core,
  rownames(Palate_epi_this_study[["RNA"]])
)

jacob_full_missing <- setdiff(
  jacob_basalTagln_full,
  rownames(Palate_epi_this_study[["RNA"]])
)

jacob_core_missing <- setdiff(
  jacob_basalTagln_core,
  rownames(Palate_epi_this_study[["RNA"]])
)

cat("Full module genes present:\n")
print(jacob_full_present)

cat("\nFull module genes missing:\n")
print(jacob_full_missing)

cat("\nCore module genes present:\n")
print(jacob_core_present)

cat("\nCore module genes missing:\n")
print(jacob_core_missing)
```

```{r}
## 删除可能存在的旧 module score
old_score_cols <- grep(
  "^Jacob_BasalTagln",
  colnames(Palate_epi_this_study@meta.data),
  value = TRUE
)

if (length(old_score_cols) > 0) {
  Palate_epi_this_study@meta.data[, old_score_cols] <- NULL
}

set.seed(123)

Palate_epi_this_study <- AddModuleScore(
  object = Palate_epi_this_study,
  features = list(jacob_full_present),
  assay = "RNA",
  name = "Jacob_BasalTagln_full",
  ctrl = 100
)

set.seed(123)

Palate_epi_this_study <- AddModuleScore(
  object = Palate_epi_this_study,
  features = list(jacob_core_present),
  assay = "RNA",
  name = "Jacob_BasalTagln_core",
  ctrl = 100
)
```
